news.title: Oct 7th (Week5)
news.body:
THREE GAMES, THREE WINS — WHITE TAKES OVER CHÂTEAUGUAY!
Week 5 of CAHL hockey MADNESS is officially in the books, and the entertainment just keeps getting better every Wednesday night!

Last night, the WHITE TEAM came to play, and apparently forgot to bring any mercy! Three games, three victories, and a whole lot of goals. The Black squad found themselves chasing the scoreboard all night, but give them credit — they never threw in the towel, never stopped battling, and kept the competitive spirit alive.

After all, CAHL hockey isn't about winning or losing... unless you're on the winning team, in which case it's EVERYTHING! 😂
 
White dominated the first two games, led by a red-hot Patrick Robertson, who apparently decided that allowing goals was no longer part of his job description. Between Robertson's spectacular saves and the offensive fireworks from Butler, Goyette, Stacey, Ford, and young gun Carter, the Black team was in for one LONG evening!

We witnessed some absolute beauties — rockets from the blue line, slick passing plays, and a few shots that had the goalies wondering whether they should have stayed home watching Netflix.

And what happened to the usually dangerous Lévesque brothers? Rumour has it that perhaps a little too much bedroom activity leading up to game night drained their scoring batteries. Then again, maybe Robertson was simply THAT GOOD! Either way, the brothers couldn't find the magic touch. Perhaps a little more sleep and a little less romance before next Wednesday, boys! 😂

Three competitive games, plenty of laughs, and another unforgettable Wednesday night in Châteauguay!

🔥 BUTLER WAS ON FIRE — SOMEONE CALL THE FIRE DEPARTMENT! 🔥🔥

Jaret Butler — 3 Goals, 1 Assist — SECOND STAR! ⭐⭐
Ladies and gentlemen, apparently Jaret Butler has been hiding a secret weapon!

Known for his relentless up-and-down skating and playmaking, Butler decided Wednesday night was the perfect opportunity to remind everyone that he can also PUT THE PUCK IN THE NET!

Three goals and one assist later, the scoreboard was smoking!

According to unconfirmed reports, paparazzi spotted Butler earlier in the afternoon circling the Walmart parking lot, firing pucks at abandoned shopping carts and practicing his wrist shots between parked cars.

Security apparently asked him to leave after he celebrated his fifth shopping-cart goal by throwing his gloves in the air.

Well, whatever training program he's following, IT'S WORKING! His performance earned him a well-deserved second star, and Walmart management is reportedly considering sponsoring his next practice session. 🛒🏒😂

🚨 MISSING IN ACTION — WHERE WERE THE BOYS?

A few familiar faces were noticeably absent from Wednesday night's action.

Howell, Rheault, and Goodleaf were all missing from the lineup — three players who normally bring energy, intensity, and their own unique brand of chaos to the ice.

Their absence certainly didn't go unnoticed, especially by the Black team, who could have used a little extra firepower!

Rumours are circulating about their whereabouts, but TSN investigators have yet to confirm whether they were nursing injuries, enjoying early bedtimes, or simply avoiding Robertson's hot glove!

Come back soon, boys — the league needs its characters! 😂

THE OFFICIAL SCOREBOARD — WEEK 5

Game 1 – Black 3, White 5
Game 2 – Black 1, White 5
Game 3 – Black 1, White 3

FINAL VERDICT: WHITE SWEEPS THE NIGHT 3–0! 🧹

Black will undoubtedly be looking for revenge next Wednesday. White, meanwhile, is probably already planning its championship parade through the Walmart parking lot!

⭐ THE THREE STARS OF THE NIGHT ⭐

🥇 1st Star — PATRICK ROBERTSON 🔥🔥🔥
The man, the myth, the brick wall! Robertson stood tall between the pipes, frustrating shooters and stealing scoring opportunities all night long. Rumour has it he's still stopping pucks in his sleep!

🥈 2nd Star — JARET BUTLER 🔥🔥
Three goals, one assist, and one very nervous Walmart security department. Butler brought the offensive fireworks and proved that parking-lot practice really does pay off!

🥉 3rd Star — MIKE STACEY 🔥
Another strong performance from Stacey, who brought his scoring touch and helped keep the White offensive machine rolling!


🎤 FINAL WORD FROM THE CAHL SPORTS DESK

The goals are getting better, the rivalries are heating up, the excuses are becoming more creative, and the postgame stories are getting harder to believe!

Remember, boys — we're not getting older, we're just getting better at blaming our equipment! 😂

See everyone next Wednesday for another edition of CAHL HOCKEY — WHERE THE LEGENDS ARE REAL, BUT THE STORIES ARE OFTEN EXAGGERATED! 🏒🍻🔥

news.title: Sept 30th (Week4)
news.body:
THREE GAMES. PLENTY OF ACTION.
Another great night of CAHL hockey with three games in the books and plenty of highlight-reel moments along the way!
Game1 Black came out flying and took it 5–1. Game2 White answered back with a convincing 5–2 victory and Game3 the rubber match was a battle right to the end, with White squeezing out a 2–1 win.
There were some absolute beauties scored throughout the night, with contributions coming from all over the ice.
Overall, the teams were pretty evenly matched… although a few “spares” showed up looking suspiciously like they had agents, endorsement deals and NHL clauses in their contracts. 
Three games, competitive hockey, a few ringers and plenty of chirping — just another Wednesday night in the CAHL!

FORD WAS ON FIRE!  🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥🔥
Shane Ford spent the better part of the week leading up to last night’s game working the farm and hanging out with his animals — and apparently, that was exactly the fuel he needed!
Ford came flying out of the gate with energy to burn, showcasing his skill set up and down the ice and setting up some incredible plays throughout the night.
But he saved his best for last.
With the game deadlocked late in the third and only 46 seconds remaining, Ford stepped up and buried the GAME-WINNING GOAL, clinching the third game of the night in dramatic fashion!
The clutch performance earned Shane Ford the 1st Star of the Game. Farm strong. Game winner. First star. What a night for Ford!

MISSING THE BREAKAWAY!
Late in the second period, Mathieu Rheault broke loose from centre ice and went one-on-one with Robertson, trying to pull off a little magic with a slick deke.
At first glance — NO GOAL! Robertson appeared to have shut the door.
Unfortunately, the CAHL video replay system was apparently experiencing the same technical difficulties it’s had since 1987, so the officials couldn’t go upstairs for a review.
But the next-morning video review told a different story — the puck had clearly crossed the line! Rheault was robbed of what would have been an absolute beauty of a breakaway goal.
Rumours are already circulating that Rheault’s agent has filed an official protest with the league and is demanding the goal, a point on the scoresheet and a formal apology from the CAHL replay department.
The goal may not be on the scoresheet… but the camera doesn’t lie! This also led to a second star spot for Rheault.

WHITE SHOWING OFF THE HANDS!
Goalie John White proved last night that he can do a lot more than just stop pucks!
White picked up a rare goalie assist, making a beautiful setup to Arune, who took it from there and went coast-to-coast before burying the goal.
You don’t see goalies picking up points very often, but this one showed off White’s confidence with the puck and his ability to use his stick to get the offence moving.
Rumour has it John was checking the scoring sheet after the game to make absolutely sure the assist was recorded.
One assist closer to the Art Ross, Johnny!

HEALTHY SCRATCH REPORT
A few familiar names were missing from the lineup last night, including Martinez, Montour, — players who normally bring the energy level up another notch.
But despite missing some firepower, the boys did just fine without them. There was also Howell is was also out as he is vacationing in the islands
Another Wednesday night in the books.

Below are the game details,
Game 1 – Black 5, White 1
Game 2 – White 5, White 2
Game 3 – Black 1, White 2

The 3 stars of the game were ,
1. Shane Ford   🔥🔥🔥🔥
2. Matieu Rheault
3. Lornee Lucas

news.title: Sept 23rd (Week3)
news.body:
A GOALTENDING BATTLE FOR THE AGES
If you were one of the lucky fans holding a ticket for last night’s matchup in Châteauguay, consider yourself privileged — you witnessed one hell of a battle between the pipes.
Replacement goalie Eric “Superman” faced an incredible 48 shots, making some absolutely spectacular saves. 
He saved some of his best work for the final six minutes, including an absolute robbery on Shane, who looked certain to bury a beauty upstairs. Superman had other plans and left Shane shaking his head — and empty-handed.

MARTINEZ IS BACK!
After taking nearly three months away from the rink, Martinez returned with one of his best performances ever, lighting the lamp THREE TIMES!
That’s right — HAT TRICK!
Rumour has it there were so many hats thrown onto the ice that officials needed 10 minutes to clean them all up. Châteauguay hasn’t seen that much headwear since the last clearance sale at Lids.

J WHITE STANDS TALL
At the other end, J White was pushing his limits with some outstanding stretch saves, doing everything possible to keep the Levesque brothers from padding their point totals.
White reportedly suffered a slight groin injury, but early reports indicate he’ll survive. Sources close to the team say the man has balls of steel, so apparently there’s not much concern in that department. 😂

TSN IS BACK
TSN was on-site again this week for exclusive pre- and post-game interviews.
All video links will be posted over the next few days, including player reactions and some hard-hitting journalism from inside the CAHL locker room.

HEALTHY SCRATCH REPORT
A few familiar names were missing from the lineup last night, including Goodleaf, Howell and Blenman — players who normally bring the energy level up another notch.
But despite missing some firepower, the boys did just fine without them.
Another Wednesday night in the books.

Big saves. Big goals. A hat trick. Balls of steel.
Just another night in the CAHL. 🏒🔥

Below are the game details, 
Game 1 – Black 5, White 1
Game 2 – Black 3, White 5
Game 3 – Black 3, White 2

The 3 stars of the game were , 
1.        Danny Martinez
2.        JF Fournier
3.        Shane Ford

news.title: Sept 16th (Week2)
news.body:
3 year contract for Carter Howell with 87 points in his last season with the hounddogs-
Chateauguay - The  CAHL league is happy to announce a 3 year deal signed in August with youngblood Carter Howell who accepted the offer to join the league during the offseason. 
Howell set a record in his first 3 seasons with his former HoundDogs team as the top goal scorer in the league finishing each season with 87 plus points. He will be a great addition to the gang. He was interviewed this week in the bathroom of the golf course while taking a dump in prep for his annual tournament and said he was really looking forward to joining to contribute to the fun of the Chateauguay league.

news.title: Sept 9th (Week1)
news.body:
3 year contract for Aruntase Paul with 55 points in his last season with the Icestingers-
Chateauguay - The  CAHL league is also pleased to announce another 3 year deal signed in August with Paul who accepted the offer to join the league during the offseason. 
Paul is a 6ft 2 roadrunner who breaks energy to the ice every game with eyes in the back if his head.  In his last season with the IceDogs, Paul locked in 98 points and as the top defensemen drafted, he will be another great addition to the league. In his interview earlier this week, Paul noted that playing with the old guys is so much more fun.

news.title: Welcome to the 2026–2027 Season!
news.body:
Hi everyone,
Great start to the winter season. The white team comeback was outstanding in week1.  As we all discussed many times, its not really cool to keep the game going after a two goal lead after hitting 5 goals as it can get out of hand but last night was an exception. The ideal way to play all games is by resetting the score back to 0 once the score hits 5 and there is a two-goal difference. I know some of you don't like that, but with spares and team balancing, its the best way. 

Collections -
A few things I want to remind everyone. If you have played one game then you should have made a payment towards your registration fees. If that's not the case, please send me an Etransfer. I feel like a bill collector, the worst part of my job is trying to collect money.

Time on the ice -
The other thing, is time on the ice per shift. Be conscious of the clock when your on the ice, try hard not to stay of the ice for 5 minutes as the next line will get cold and will get angry and do the same thing. Be fair which will result in more icetime all around.

The Referee -
The last thing we all want to hear are complaints on the ice that Nick missed a call or and offside or didn't see a slashing call or whatever. Please refrain from giving nick comments. This is garage hockey and the ultimate goal is to have fun, a few good laughs and of course a few cold beers or Gatorade after the game.
